user.description: System user account under which OpenDMARC runs (must have minimal privileges).

socket_path.description: Unix domain socket path for communication with the MTA (e.g., Postfix).

pid_file.description: File to store the process PID.

syslog.description: Syslog facility/log level (info, warning, error, critical).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to syslog.

trusted_authserv_ids.description: List of trusted authentication service IDs (used when multiple services are present).

items.description: IP address or CIDR subnet for internal hosts.

internal_hosts.description: List of internal hosts (trusted IP ranges) that bypass DMARC checks for reporting.

items.description: IP address, hostname, or CIDR subnet to ignore during DMARC enforcement.

ignore_hosts.description: List of hosts (IPs or domains) whose mail should be ignored (exempt from enforcement).

whitelist_file.description: Path to file listing domains/addresses to exempt from DMARC enforcement (one per line).

failure_reports.description: Whether to send DMARC failure reports to policy publishers.

failure_reports_sent_by.description: Envelope sender address used in failure reports (must be valid for DNS verification).

reports_directory.description: Directory to store aggregated DMARC reports before sending.

report_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) to rotate and send reports (0 disables scheduled sending).

report_bounce.description: Return address for failure reports (used for bounce handling).

report_rate_interval.description: Minimum interval (seconds) between reports sent to the same domain.

ststls.description: Enable MTA-STS (strict transport security) for policy discovery.

sts_file.description: Path to the MTA-STS policy file (optional).

signature_key_file.description: Private key file for DKIM signing of failure reports.

signature_key_selector.description: DKIM selector used when signing failure reports (must match DNS TXT record).

strip_attachment.description: Strip message attachments from failure reports (recommended for privacy/security).

report_min_quorum.description: Minimum number of matching failures to trigger a report (prevents spammy reports).

items.description: DMARC result types to include in failure reports.

failure_types.description: List of failure types to report. 'fail' is most common.

use_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 for outbound SMTP connections when sending reports.

log_why.description: Log the detailed reason for each DMARC decision (SPF/DKIM alignment result).

ignore_authenticated_clients.description: Skip DMARC checks for authenticated clients (e.g., mail from SMTP AUTH users).

reject_failures.description: Reject mail that fails DMARC with p=reject (not recommended during initial rollout).

add_received_spf.description: Add 'Received-SPF' header to messages (helps with debugging).

arf_template.description: Path to custom Abuse Reporting Format (ARF) template (advanced).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent report-sending worker threads.

max_report_size.description: Maximum size (bytes) of a single report file; larger files are split (0 = no limit).

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname to use for sending DMARC failure reports (if external SMTP is desired).

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (25 for unencrypted, 465 or 587 for TLS).

smtp_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for SMTP operations (connection + data transfer).

smtp_use_tls.description: Enable STARTTLS when connecting to the SMTP server.

smtp_verify_tls.description: Verify SMTP server certificate when TLS is used.

smtp_username.description: SMTP username for authentication (if required by the SMTP server).

smtp_password.description: SMTP password for authentication (if required; consider secure file/env injection instead).

failure_reports.description: Override: whether to send failure reports for this domain.

ignore_hosts.description: Override: hosts to ignore for this domain.
